reason: A normal 7 kg semi-automatic in the market costs around ten to twelve thousand, and this is double that just for a battery. My inverter already keeps things running when the power goes, so I would rather buy a plain machine or a bigger inverter battery that helps the whole house.
objection: Twenty-two thousand for a washing machine is a premium price, and I am paying extra for a battery that only does two loads when my inverter can already do the job.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost close to an ordinary semi-automatic, around thirteen or fourteen thousand, with the battery included.
